scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
Desert City Veins welcomes adventurers seeking shelter from harsh sandstorms.
If this is the first time for you to use the guide services, why don't you check the...
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯向导]
沙漠之城伯仁斯欢迎前来躲避猛烈沙尘暴的冒险者。
如果您是第一次使用向导服务，不妨先看看...

scripts.text: Village Guide
scripts.translation: 村庄导览

scripts.text: Remove Marks from Mini-Map
scripts.translation: 移除小地图标记

scripts.text: Notice
scripts.translation: 告示

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Veins.
So where do you want to go?
Would you like me
to mark locations
on your Mini-Map?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯向导]
只要是伯仁斯的建筑，我都能告诉您在哪里。
您想去哪儿呢？
需要我在您的小地图上标记地点吗？

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Veins.
So where do you want to go?
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯向导]
只要是伯仁斯的建筑，我都能告诉您在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Veins.
So where do you want to go?
[Veins Guide]
Our temple is located north,
and always crowded with sincere followers of Goddess Freya.
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯向导]
只要是伯仁斯的建筑，我都能告诉您在哪里。
您想去哪儿呢？
[伯仁斯向导]
我们的神殿位于北边，那里总是挤满了女神芙蕾雅的虔诚信徒。

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Veins.
So where do you want to go?
[Veins Guide]
You can rest your fatigue of the journey in the Inn.
The left building next to me is the Inn of Veins.
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯向导]
只要是伯仁斯的建筑，我都能告诉您在哪里。
您想去哪儿呢？
[伯仁斯向导]
您可以在旅馆休息，消除旅途的疲劳。
我左边这栋楼就是伯仁斯的旅馆。

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Veins.
So where do you want to go?
[Veins Guide]
Yes, you should protect yourself from danger on your own.
Purchase high quality weapons at affordable prices.
The Veins Weapon Shop is located to the West.
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯向导]
只要是伯仁斯的建筑，我都能告诉您在哪里。
您想去哪儿呢？
[伯仁斯向导]
是啊，遇到危险时，您得靠自己保护自己。
不妨买些物美价廉的武器。
伯仁斯的武器店就在西边。

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Veins.
So where do you want to go?
[Veins Guide]
Have you packed enough necessities  for your adventure?
If not, I suggest you check what the Veins in the Center can offer you.
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯向导]
只要是伯仁斯的建筑，我都能告诉您在哪里。
您想去哪儿呢？
[伯仁斯向导]
您为冒险备足必需品了吗？
如果还没有，不妨去镇中心的道具店看看有什么用得上的东西。

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Veins.
So where do you want to go?
[Veins Guide]
Please be aware that Veins only operates cargo airships.
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯向导]

您想去哪儿呢？
[伯仁斯向导]
请注意，伯仁斯只运营货运飞空艇。

scripts.text:

I can tell you any building location as long as it is in Veins.
So where do you want to go?
[Veins Guide]
If you'd like to make friends with
the townspeople, I suggest you
go have a drink at the tavern to
the west.
scripts.translation:

如果想结识镇上的居民，不妨去西边的酒馆喝一杯。

scripts.text:

So where do you want to go?
[Veins Guide]
Are you interested in studying geology?
Then you'd better go check out the
Geological Research Institute on
the 2nd floor of the weapon shop.
scripts.translation:

您想去哪儿呢？
[伯仁斯向导]
您对地质学感兴趣吗？
那就去武器店二楼的地质研究所看看吧。

[Veins Guide]
Okay, they are gone now. If you have more locations to ask, just let me know.
Enjoy your stay in Veins.

还想问其他地点的话，随时告诉我。
祝您在伯仁斯度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
When you are using the ''Village Guide'' menu,
make sure that building locations will be marked on your mini-map at the upper right side of your screen.
If you cannot see your mini-map, use the short cut key ''ctrl+tab'' or press the ''Map'' button on your basic information windows, okay?
And you can also zoom out your mini-map by using the ''-'' button in case you cannot view the entire map of the village.
scripts.translation:
[伯仁斯向导]
使用“村庄导览”菜单时，请确认建筑的位置已标记在屏幕右上角的小地图上。
如果看不到小地图，就按快捷键Ctrl + Tab，或点击基本信息窗口中的“地图”按钮，好吗？
如果看不到整个村庄的地图，还可以点击“-”按钮缩小小地图。

scripts.text:
[Veins Guide]
Enjoy your stay in Veins.
scripts.translation:

祝您在伯仁斯度过愉快的时光。
